The '''Echo Isles''' {{coords|64|85|Durotar}} are a handful of small islands off the southeastern coast of [[Durotar]]. For a while, the [[Darkspear trolls]] lived here, but when the [[Kul Tiras]] fleet attacked their land, they had to flee. They evacuated with the help of the [[Mok'Nathal]] [[Rexxar]].

After the [[Third War]], when the [[Horde]] settled in Durotar, [[Thrall]] made these islands off the southern tip available to the Darkspears. Recently, a Darkspear troll named [[Zalazane]] decided that his brethren did not need the [[orcs]] as allies and began practicing [[necromancy]]. He drove the Horde-loyal Darkspears off of the islands, converted followers, and created the [[zombie]]s who now inhabit the Echo Isles.

While attempts have been made to oust [[Zalazane]] and reclaim the islands, his forces are too numerous compared to the weakened [[Darkspear tribe]]. They now live on the coast of mainland Durotar in [[Sen'jin Village]], in the [[Valley of Spirits]] within [[Orgrimmar]], and in other scattered parts of [[Azeroth (world)|Azeroth]].

Popular in World of Warcraft as a low-level training ground and as a taming ground for hunters wanting raptor or cat pets.
